script: if(window.__sniffBridgeInited!==true){function sniffResource(){var list=document.querySelectorAll('.videos .video');if(!list||0==list.length){sendResourceList([]);return}const function sniffPlayUrl(){const iframe=await waitForElement('#playleft iframe',10,200);if(iframe){let filename=path.split('/').pop();return filename}function waitForElement(selector,maxRetry=10,intervalMs=200){return new Promise((resolve)=>{let count=0;function poll(){const
